en-US.longDescription: Speak naturally, and Typeless will turn your words into polished messages, emails, and documents that read like you carefully typed them - in real time. 4x faster than typing.
en-US.name: Typeless
en-US.releaseNotes:
Typeless × Anker

Today, we're announcing an official partnership between Typeless and Anker to bring the future of voice-first work closer to reality.
We believe the future of work is spoken, not typed.
By bringing Anker's soundcore Work wearable microphone to Typeless, we're making voice-first work possible in more places, from private home offices to shared workspaces. Speak naturally, even in a whisper, and let Typeless turn your thoughts into clear writing.
Small, lightweight, and designed to be worn on your collar, soundcore Work keeps the microphone close to your mouth for clearer voice capture. Even in shared offices, you can speak softly and let Typeless capture your thoughts without having to raise your voice or disturb those around you.
With long battery life and a hands-free design, soundcore Work makes it easy to use Typeless throughout your workday, whether you're sending messages and emails, interacting with AI, or writing longer documents.
Together with Anker, we're making voice a more natural way to work, anywhere.
Learn more
